messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- On 2026-05-22, team Dune reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- The Cinder team runs its planning on Mondays. [valid 2026-04-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-03]
- As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-16]
- The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- The Cinder team adopted trunk-based development. [decision; valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2]
- On 2026-03-11, the Cinder team observed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2]
- The team Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-4]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- On 2026-06-09, team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]

Question: Why was the scheduler moved from Dune to Cinder?

message.reasoning:
The question asks why the scheduler was moved from Dune to Cinder. Looking at the memory, I see entries about the handover on 2025-09-23, but no reason is given for the handover. The memory says "As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then" — but no reason is stated.

There's a reason for leader election (single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run), but that's not about the team ownership change.

So the answer is: I don't know.
